chapter.verse: Sang Penpa aw, Topa tungah lungdam lah ding, nangma min phatna sak ding; zang sawm khausai lasakna leh harp lasakna, laiza lasaknate tumin, zingsangin nangma itna kip, zanin na thumanna genkhiat dingin a kilawm hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa aw, nangma nasepna tawh kei hong lungdamsak a, nangma nasepnate hangin lungdamin la ka sa hi.
Topa, na sepnate bangzah takin lian! Na ngaihsutnate thuk mahmah!

Migilote lopa bangin selkhia-in, siatna bawl khempeuh a pun’ hangin, amaute pen a tawntungin siatna a thuak ding ahi uh hi; ahih hangin, Topa aw, nang pen asangna-ah a om tawntung na hihna thu, lungsim mawl mi in theithei lo a, lungsim tei lo mi in tel thei lo hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh, Topa aw, na galte en in, bang hang hiam cih leh, en in, na galte beimang ding hi; siatna bawl khempeuhte kithehthang ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin nangmah in zangsial bangin kei nong hatsak a, kei tungah thupha hong pia-in nong lungdam sak hi.
Ka galte’ pukna ka mitte in mu khin a, keimah hong do a gilote’ siatna ka bilte in za khin ta hi.
Thuman mi in nisuh kung bangin palh a, Lebanon mual tunga taamtaak kung bangin a khang hi.
Topa ’ inn sungah amaute kisuan a, i Pasian’ huang sungah amaute palh uh hi.
Topa thutang hi ci-a a lah nadingin amaute teek napi-in gah lailai uh a, amaute tui kiuhkeuh-in hing sitset uh hi; amah ka Suangpi hi a, ama sungah thuman lohna om lo hi.
